sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Importation of Deep-Frozen Meat Carcasses and Pelagic Fish

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; VFSC corporate registry seated at Port Vila, Efate Island)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law heritage with customary law overlay; unitary national company law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive double taxation avoidance agreement (DTAA) currently in force
Tax information exchange arrangements with Australia and New Zealand (TIEA-type, non-comprehensive)
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement (Vanuatu as contracting party)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) framework for trade in goods and services

No standalone bilateral investment treaty with major capital-exporting states; foreign equity entry is governed by the VIPA foreign investment approval regime and International Companies Act exemptions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 20 of 2023 (as amended); VFIU AML/CFT Guidance; International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; International Companies (Economic Substance) Act No. 26 of 2021; VFSC AML/CFT supervisory rulebook; Business Licence Act No. 18 of 2008; Biosecurity Act No. 8 of 2013.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity card of each proposed shareholder, director, secretary and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport or identity authority of the document holder's country of origin, attested by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961, in force for Vanuatu) OR Consular Legalization where the originating state is not an Apostille Party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 90 days) for each director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company or bank in the country of residence, notarized locally

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter confirming account conduct of each UBO and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the UBO or corporate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization only where the bank letter must be relied upon as a certified public document; otherwise accepted as an original commercial document

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / certificate of good conduct for each director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal records authority of each country of residence for the preceding 10 years

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and constitutional documents of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry and notary of the incorporation jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The appointed VFSC-licensed registered agent must screen all shareholders, directors, secretaries and UBOs against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list including 50% ownership rules, UK HMT and EU consolidated sanctions, INTERPOL Red Notices, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit domestic adverse and advisory lists before engagement and on a continuing basis. PEPs require enhanced due diligence including source of wealth and source of funds verification under the AML/CFT Act No. 20 of 2023. The VFSC treats wholesale importation of deep-frozen meat carcasses and pelagic fish as a Low_Risk_Standard banking tier, but requires full transaction monitoring on Swift TT and revolving LC payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registration portal (official website: www.vfsc.vu), submitted through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Latin/Roman characters; English and French names are acceptable; non-Roman script names require a notarized transliteration into English or French. The name must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any existing registered company, reserved name or registered trademark and must bear an acceptable limited-liability suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Inc.', 'Société Anonyme' or 'S.A.'
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Vanuatu where the use implies government patronage
international company as a stand-alone or misleading suffix
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected applicant or its registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Companies Registry within 14 calendar days of the refusal notice, stating the grounds on which the proposed name complies with the naming requirements of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The VFSC must issue a decision within 21 working days. If the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may either submit a fresh name clearance application with a revised name, or initiate judicial review proceedings before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. A granted name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the prescribed fee before the expiry of the original reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The statutory registered office must be a physical address in Vanuatu provided by a VFSC-licensed registered agent and may be used as a virtual registered-office service for administrative and correspondence purposes. A purely virtual business office without any local operational presence is not acceptable for the proposed cold-chain import activity, because the Department of Customs, the Vanuatu Biosecurity Authority and the Ministry of Trade require a named local importer, an operational contact address, and, for frozen meats and pelagic fish, compliant cold-storage or transshipment arrangements. Brokerage and remote trading functions may nevertheless be administered from an offshore back office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-low: approximately 15-20% annual probability within the first operational year, driven primarily by VFSC registered-agent due-diligence audits, Customs and Inland Revenue verification visits, and biosecurity cold-chain inspections at the designated Vanuatu port of entry.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille / consular legalization bundle (passport, address proof, police clearance, bank reference letter, POA)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1994, Cap. 222 (Laws of the Republic of Vanuatu), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2011; Part II, sections 7–12 (formation and incorporation), sections 27–33 (shares, registered office and registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Division, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber and lodged with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation) and a Declaration of Compliance, resulting in the Certificate of Incorporation issued under section 12(2) of the International Companies Act, Cap. 222
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; authorized share capital is typically USD 10,000–50,000 divided into ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each; no escrow account or capital verification deposit is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [IC NAME] Adopted by the first director by written resolution on [DATE] at the registered office, Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED: 1. The allotment under the Memorandum of Association is ratified and the subscribed shares are issued to the founding shareholder at par. 2. The registered office located at [AGENT ADDRESS], Port Vila, Vanuatu, care of [REGISTERED AGENT], is adopted. 3. [DIRECTOR NAME] is appointed Managing Director and [SECRETARY NAME] is appointed Secretary. 4. The Managing Director is authorized to open bank accounts, execute frozen beef and seafood import contracts, and file all regulatory applications. 5. The Common Seal, if adopted, shall be affixed only under two-officer authority. Signed by the Director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search, Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Division, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent and submit two ranked company name choices each carrying the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' The Registrar checks the International Companies Register for identical or confusingly similar names and reserves an available name for a 30-day reservation period.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request with two ranked choices
List of proposed directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as identical, similar or undesirable, immediately file a fresh reservation with alternative names; a written appeal may be lodged with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and notary public in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form under section 11(1) of the International Companies Act, Cap. 222. The founding shareholder executes the document before a notary or qualified witness, and the agent certifies the Declaration of Compliance confirming all statutory pre-conditions set out in section 11(2).
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified passport copies of the shareholder and directors
Consent to act forms of directors and secretary
Bank reference letter for the founding shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any constitutional clause, the agent files a corrective supplementary memorandum and re-submits; purely ministerial corrections attract no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Division, VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges the executed M&A, Form IC-1 and the VFSC fee payment. The Registrar reviews the filing against sections 7–12 of the Act, enters the company in the International Companies Register, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the seal of the Registrar. The company is then a body corporate with perpetual succession.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is refused, request written particulars of the defect and re-file corrected documents; administrative review may be sought from the Registrar within 30 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions, Officer Appointment and Statutory Register Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Managing Director and Secretary acting under the First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The directors execute the written First Board Resolution adopting the registered office and registered agent, ratifying the share issuance, and appointing the Managing Director and Secretary. The company then opens its statutory registers of members, directors, officers and charges, which must be maintained at the registered office in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Statutory registers of members, directors, officers and charges
Consent to act of each appointed officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointed officer is disqualified by VFSC (for example an undischarged bankrupt), pass a replacement board resolution and file amended register pages within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License, Foreign Investment Certificate and Customs Importer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (Business License Office) and Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because wholesale importation supplies the Vanuatu market, file the Business License application under the Business License Act [Cap. 252] with the Customs and Inland Revenue Service and obtain a Foreign Investment Approval Certificate from VIPA for the qualifying foreign investment. Register with Vanuatu Customs to obtain an Importer Code for customs declarations of frozen beef and pelagic fish, and register for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 283] if taxable supplies exceed the registration threshold.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business License is refused on public-interest grounds, appeal to the Minister of Finance and Trade within 30 days; if the license is denied because an International Company may not trade domestically, restructure local distribution through a licensed local agent or, alternatively, continue as a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap. 191].

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry and Trade, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for foreign investment screening
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License (Business License Act, Cap. 252) for wholesale cold-chain meat and seafood trading; Vanuatu Quarantine Import Permit under the Biosecurity Act for each frozen carcass and pelagic fish consignment; Customs Importer Code for duty processing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Environment, Energy and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration tier — Preliminary Environmental Review (PER) only; no full Environmental Impact Assessment report required for a leased cold-storage and freezer import facility
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewer: BOD ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 60 mg/L, pH 6.0–9.0, fat/oil/grease ≤ 30 mg/L; refrigeration systems: zero CFC/HCFC emissions under the Ozone Depleting Substances Regulations, ammonia (R-717) or CO2 (R-744) with annual leak testing; condemned carcasses and spoiled seafood must be disposed only through a DEPC-approved rendering or incineration contractor; solid waste segregation per the National Waste Management (PMC) Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service covering structural load inspection of cold storage racking and insulated panels, clean-agent or CO2 fire suppression, emergency egress and smoke detection; Occupational Health and Safety clearance from the Department of Labor under the OHS Act [Cap. 229] covering forklift operator licensing, ammonia leak detection with audible alarms, PPE including thermal suits and gloves, and cold-room entrapment rescue drills; Biosecurity clearance from Vanuatu Quarantine and Inspection Services per consignment requiring a valid country-of-origin veterinary certificate, container seal integrity, and temperature log verification confirming product core temperature of −18°C or below at discharge.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VCIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; statutory VAT registration, VAT returns, customs duties and trade clearances are administered under the Value Added Tax Act and the Customs Act through the ASYCUDA World electronic customs declaration portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company may obtain a Vanuatu VAT/TIN reference after completing incorporation under the International Companies Act and receiving approval of the registered agent and registration confirmation from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). The IC must submit the statutory VAT registration application to VCIRD together with the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, VFSC certificate of good standing, registered agent letter, description of taxable activities, and evidence of intended import/export transactions. VCIRD processes the registration, issues a VAT registration number, and activates the customs operator code in ASYCUDA World. No income tax registration is required because Vanuatu imposes no income tax and an International Company is statutorily tax-exempt.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu has no general income tax, no check-the-box classification, no hybrid mismatch election, and no fiscal transparency election. The International Company's tax exemption is statutory and automatic. VAT classification is determined solely by the Value Added Tax Act; a registered IC may voluntarily apply for VAT registration below the compulsory turnover threshold, but entity-level income tax classification elections are not available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (five million vatu) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; compulsory VAT registration arises when actual or expected annual taxable turnover exceeds the threshold, and voluntary VAT registration is available below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently operate a mandatory real-time electronic invoicing or digital fiscal stamping clearance system for domestic VAT invoices. Registered persons must issue and retain VAT invoices containing the prescribed particulars under the VAT Act. All import and export entries are cleared electronically through ASYCUDA World; import VAT must be declared and settled at customs clearance as a condition of release, and export entries are validated against the zero-rating evidence package.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered International Company may zero-rate an export supply if: (1) the goods are exported by or on behalf of the supplier from Vanuatu to a destination outside Vanuatu; (2) the goods are consigned under a customs export declaration and leave the Vanuatu customs territory within the prescribed period; (3) the transaction is at arm's length with a non-resident buyer; (4) the supplier retains title and export risk until departure; and (5) the supporting export documentation is complete. The frozen beef and seafood import business may also zero-rate a direct re-export or offshore sale, provided the goods are not consumed in Vanuatu and physical export is fully evidenced. Services supplied to a non-resident and performed outside Vanuatu are similarly zero-rated if the statutory conditions and proof of foreign receipt are satisfied.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (ASYCUDA World export entry) authenticated by Vanuatu Customs
Bill of lading or air waybill showing departure from Vanuatu and destination outside Vanuatu
Commercial invoice and packing list with HS codes, quantity, weight and product description
Inward remittance certificate or bank SWIFT/telex confirmation showing receipt of export proceeds
VAT registration certificate and import entry/import declaration evidencing customs duty and import VAT paid at import
Certificate of origin if required by the destination jurisdiction for tariff preference purposes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VCIRD and Vanuatu Customs scrutinize export zero-rating claims by reference to the full documentary trail and may suspend refunds pending verification. If an export zero-rating claim fails, the VAT is reassessed at 12.5% with retrospective clawback of any input VAT credits already refunded; statutory penalty tax and interest accrue on the under-declared VAT. Fraudulent zero-rating documentation attracts criminal prosecution, monetary penalties, and direct liability for directors and officers; a knowingly false export declaration may also result in customs seizure, forfeiture, and revocation or suspension of the IC's VAT registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) under the Central Banking Act [Cap.125]; no dedicated foreign-exchange control bureau exists; RBV performs monetary regulation, payments-system oversight and balance-of-payments statistics, with delegated supervision under the Payments and Clearing Systems Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible in both current-account and capital-account channels. Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control approval, no currency rationing and no repatriation restriction for non-resident-owned International Companies. Dividend payments, profit remittances, loan repayments and investment capital may be wired freely through any RBV-licensed commercial bank. The only practical hurdles are (1) bank-led source-of-funds documentation; (2) the AML/CFT Act reporting thresholds for cash and suspicious transactions; and (3) customs and statistical documentation if the goods enter the domestic customs territory. If the IC operates purely in a bonded import/re-export or international wholesale modality, no domestic profit-remittance bottleneck arises at all.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu maintains no statutory requirement to surrender export proceeds and no mandatory conversion ratio. An IC may retain all re-export receipts, including proceeds from frozen beef and pelagic fish trades, in VUV, USD, AUD or other cleared currencies. The only obligations are commercial-bank recordation for balance-of-payments purposes and, where goods are re-exported under bond, customs verification via transit or customs-warehouse documentation. No percentage of hard-currency export earnings must be converted into VUV.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Trade Finance (Funded LC / Trust Receipt / Multi-currency clearing)
Operational Account in VUV/USD/AUD for wholesale treasury and escrow
Operational Account and offshore treasury sweep for Asian-Pacific supplier settlements
Local escrow and government-related settlement account (limited correspondent network)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM-LOW. A Vanuatu International Company may not lawfully operate an unlicensed local payment business; a third-country digital EMI (Airwallex, Currencycloud, Ebury or similar) is not a substitute for an RBV-licensed bank because it lacks local deposit-licence status and cannot support a supply-chain LC or customs-bond guarantee. Such EMIs are viable only as a supplementary FX engine for incidental operating expenses and small supplier prepayments, and only where (a) the EMI holds a regulated licence in an FATF-compliant jurisdiction (AUSTRAC, FCA, MAS or FINMA); (b) every transaction is mirrored by an underlying invoice; and (c) the contractual stamp is attached to a domestic bank record. Continued sole reliance on an offshore EMI exposes the IC to de-risking, frozen funds and unavailability of Letters of Credit.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory obligation requires the directors or beneficial owners of a VU IC to appear physically in Vanuatu. All leading banks permit a hybrid remote onboarding: board resolutions, registers, beneficial-ownership declarations and signatory passports are notarised in the home country and apostilled; a VFSC-licensed registered agent then presents the bundle and conducts the bank interview in Port Vila. Video-verification calls with each beneficial owner are mandatory. Where the expected annual throughput exceeds approximately USD 5 million, or the compliance score is elevated, the bank may request one visit to Port Vila for the authorised signatory to execute the master account-holder mandate in person; this is a bank policy threshold, not an RBV legal rule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity of an International Company with bearer-type freedoms, nominee directors and zero minimum capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and company extract issued within 30 days; certified statutory register of shareholders and directors; sworn beneficial-ownership declaration by the registered agent; nominee-director resignation letter; the corporate group chain demonstrating the real individual owner and source of funding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse-media and jurisdiction-risk flag because Vanuatu appears on tax-haven watch-lists and the product is a sensitive cold-chain commodity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IC Tax Exemption Certificate; customs bonded-warehouse or international-wholesale licence; genuine commercial contract for ISIC 4632 (frozen carcass and pelagic fish) with fixed quantity, freezing standard, shipping terms and price; evidence of economic substance in Vanuatu: physical registered office, local registered agent, annual reporting compliance and bank memorandum describing the lawful treasury route.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk seafood-sourcing corridor involving flag-of-convenience fishing vessels or suppliers in jurisdictions with negative FATF/OFAC scoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ship-name IMO registry trace; catch certificates with FAO/UN port-state measures; freezing temperature log and manifest of refrigeration container; original health, phytosanitary and vessel certificate bundle; Indonesian, Indian and Asia-Pacific supplier due-diligence file including corporate retention documentation and no-sanction representation letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Abnormal wire pattern: advance partial payment, split disbursements to third-party freight forwarders or rapid change of beneficiary bank details.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified import/sales contract; commercial invoice aligned to LC and bill of lading; insurance certificate; payment-authority matrix and Treasury Liquidity Plan confirming Stage-4 signatory limits; RBV balance-of-payments purpose codes; the customised KYC file showing each counterparty as a pre-approved listed trade counterparty; parental corporate guarantee in support of the IC.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity or shareholder-loan funds are wired by the overseas parent in USD or AUD via SWIFT MT103 from an OECD or ASEAN licensed bank directly to the VU IC account held at a tier-1 RBV-licensed bank. The MT103 field 70 must state the corporate purpose, for example Capital Increase pursuant to board resolution date, and the beneficiary account must be pre-notified. No RBV prior approval is required, but the receiving bank will file balance-of-payments statistical returns, and large customer due-diligence checks of USD 1 million or above are anticipated; a pre-positioned source-of-funds file, corporate group chart and audited parent accounts reduce clearing time to one to two business days. For tax-exempt status, the inbound capital is recorded in the International Companies Act records and must not be mischaracterised as trading revenue subject to any Vanuatu duty.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) Irrevocable confirmed Letter of Credit under UCP600 for the underlying frozen meat and seafood consignment, issued by ANZ or BSP and advised through the seller's bank, being the primary rail for high-value cargo; (2) SWIFT MT103 for freight, insurance, customs-bond and pre-approved open-account payments up to USD 100,000 per shipment; (3) documents-against-payment at sight only for established supplier relationships and re-export modalities. Disbursements above VUV 10 million are automatically routed to the bank's senior compliance officer; each payment is matched against quarantine permit, commercial invoice, shipping manifest and real-time cold-chain temperature record. The IC must maintain a hard segregation of trade disbursements and treasury hedge settlements to avoid piercing tax-exempt substance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot VUV/USD and VUV/AUD conversion at the RBV daily benchmark rate through tier-1 domestic banks for operational working capital.
Offshore USD/AUD and USD/NZD deliverable forwards and exchange-traded options executed by the parent treasury desk of an OECD regulated bank, with no local VUV leg.

USD/VUV non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracted with an offshore licensed bank; the NDF is permissible only where the domestic account bank confirms that the IC has no VUV credit exposure and the fixing fallback clause is based on the RBV published rate.

Cross-currency swap (CCS) between USD and AUD/VUV to match long-term capital and shareholder debt refinancing, provided the hedge is commercial-risk based, booked under IFRS 9 hedge documentation, and arranged through a VFSC-licensed dealer if booked onshore.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee and continuing International Company status confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; no statutory annual return form is required for a standard non-regulated International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late administration charges accrue on overdue renewal fees; persistent non-payment will cause VFSC to invoice, demand, and then strike the company off the International Companies Register, resulting in loss of separate legal personality; restoration is discretionary and subject to arrears plus restoration fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Re-confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu-licensed registered agent / registered office provider (mandatory under the International Companies Act)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual renewal date and within 14 days of any change of registered agent or registered office address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and physical registered office is a continuing contravention; VFSC may issue a notice of default and, after notice, strike off the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Register and UBO Verification (internal register audit / beneficial ownership confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company registers maintained at the registered office; available to the registered agent and VFSC upon lawful request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the renewal date and at each share transfer; register of members must be updated within 14 days of a transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Defective, unavailable, or untruthful registers expose directors and the company to fines and daily default penalties under the International Companies Act; the company may also be denied restoration if struck off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for a non-regulated International Company based solely on revenue, assets, or number of shareholders. A certified audit becomes compulsory only if the company holds a VFSC-issued regulated financial licence (e.g., banking, insurance, securities, or money services), or if the company’s articles of association or shareholders mandate one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Vanuatu statutory accounting standard is prescribed for tax-exempt International Companies. Records must fairly disclose financial position and explain transactions under the International Companies Act; IFRS (or IFRS for SMEs) is the customary recognized framework when an audit is required by a VFSC licence or by a shareholder agreement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu does not maintain a public UBO register. The licensed registered agent must collect and retain current beneficial ownership information under AML/CFT rules. Annually, at the renewal date, and at every direct or indirect shareholding transfer, the ultimate beneficial owner must execute a standard confirmation notice documenting the natural-person owner, holding percentage, and source of funds; the company secretary/agent also updates the statutory registers. The records must remain at the Vanuatu registered office for inspection by competent authorities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: UBO/AML File (confidential register kept by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900–1,500 per annum including registered agent, registered office, and basic company secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500–5,000 per annum (only if a VFSC-regulated licence or shareholder resolution makes audit necessary)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu has no national corporate income tax; International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt from all income tax on both domestic and offshore income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full tax exemption for International Companies; no capital gains tax, no estate duty, no stamp duty on IC share transfers; no VAT in force (enabling legislation awaiting commencement). Loss carryforward is moot because the tax base is nil.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. Mandatory filing is the International Companies Act Annual Return and Licence Fee Renewal, lodged with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the online IC registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual licence fee and return due on or before each anniversary of incorporation; where a relevant activity is performed, the Economic Substance annual return must be filed within 90 days after the financial year end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and IC Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name and International Company registration number as issued by the VFSC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact IC name; non-resident beneficial owners are not disclosed in this public filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Address must remain a Vietnamese registered office; PO Box only is not acceptable without a physical address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed resident agent appointed under the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident IC must maintain a licensed VFSC agent; change of agent must be notified within 30 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and shareholding details of directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted; minimum of one director and one shareholder, corporate or natural, of any nationality.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of payable annual government licence fee and declaration of continued compliance with the Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment can be remitted by the resident agent via wire transfer; no tax return or income declaration is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-certification whether the IC carries on a relevant activity (e.g., distribution and service centre business).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If affirmed, a full Economic Substance return with management, employees, premises, and expenditure details must follow in Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-payment of the annual licence fee attracts a fixed penalty of approximately VUV 10,000 plus monthly interest accruals; persistent default leads to registration strike-off and deregistration. False ESR declarations expose the IC to monthly fines up to VUV 1,000,000 escalating to VUV 2,000,000 per month and eventual cancellation of the IC.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu does not impose withholding tax on dividends; IC dividends may be repatriated to non-resident shareholders free of any deduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network relevant to dividend relief; because the statutory WHT is nil, no DTA claim, no tax treaty relief application, and no Tax Residency Certificate submission is required to achieve zero withholding on outbound distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on interest and royalties; where thin treaty instruments exist they also preserve 0%. Cross-border payments for IP royalties and debt interest leave Vanuatu without deduction and without reporting to the tax authority.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Vanuatu has no codified transfer-pricing law and no VUV threshold (VUV 0 / N/A) triggering mandatory Local File or Master File preparation; related-party transactions nevertheless must be supported by contemporaneous records if the IC declares an ESR relevant activity.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations (International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019) apply to ICs carrying on relevant activities, which include a Distribution and Service Centre business such as wholesale import and trading. The IC must show management and control exercised in Vanuatu, adequate local premises, sufficient local employees, and proportionate local operating expenditure, and must file an annual Economic Substance return with the VFSC; the cold-chain import business must therefore either maintain genuine substance in Vanuatu or demonstrate that distribution activities are not core to its commercial model.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Declarations to VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing false annual returns or ESR declarations, concealing beneficial ownership, or misrepresenting turnover and distributions to preserve the IC tax-exempt facade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of IC registration, penalty assessments up to VUV 500,000 per offence, and compulsory strike-off or liquidation; referral to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations face civil restitution orders, travel bans pending investigation, disqualification from management, and imprisonment up to 3 years for fraud offences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the frozen meat and seafood IC as a brass-plate entity with no Vanuatu presence, no records, no employees, and no board control while claiming international trading activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR non-compliance fines of VUV 1,000,000 for the first month of default and VUV 2,000,000 for each subsequent month, cancellation of IC status, and direction to wind up.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fines, disqualification orders, travel restrictions pending ESR correction, and imprisonment up to 12 months for continued willful breach.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the import entity and its Swift TT / revolving LC payment rails to layer and launder proceeds of crime, or evading customer due diligence and transaction record-keeping under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fines up to VUV 10,000,000, licence revocation, asset forfeiture, and public deregistration; breach of threshold reporting can trigger referral to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors and compliance officers are criminally liable for willful AML breach, facing imprisonment up to 15 years, personal confiscation of benefits, and civil liability jointly and severally with the company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directors approving concealed related-party margins, using false cold-chain invoices to defraud creditors, or draining the IC for personal benefit while leaving import obligations unpaid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Winding-up orders, fines up to VUV 200,000 per contravention, and claw-back of misapplied corporate assets under the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: directors are jointly and severally liable for company debts, subject to civil restitution, travel bans under enforcement orders, and imprisonment up to 7 years for fraudulent trading.
